item.title: Destin crash leaves multiple people hospitalized
item.description: DESTIN, Fla. (WKRG) — Destin Fire Rescue officials had to extract a person from their vehicle after a crash Sunday night. According to a DFR Facebook post, the two-vehicle crash happened in front of Whole Foods. Officials said multiple people were taken to Fort Walton Beach Medical Center for treatment.
